messages:
Maria Chen: Quick heads-up — starting a compatibility sweep for "nova-34b" onboarding. Noticed tokenizer is splitting CRLF differently on the release weights. Anyone seen this? :eyes:

Ben Ortiz: Where are the weights? I can run a quick md5 check.

Maria Chen: gs://redwood-weights/onboard/nova-34b/v1 (permissions: redwood-weights-read). Also staged a local copy at /tmp/nova34b/v1. Can someone validate shard count matches our loader (expect 4 shards).

Jess Patel: I'll check shard count. Also FYI tokenizer.json has an extra sentinel token "<|nl|>" — may impact prefix caching and KV reuse.

Ravi Singh: That sentinel was added during dataset conversion; it's not present in tokenizer.vocab. If missing it will fallback to <unk> and break some GQA prompt templates.

Samir (oncall): pinging eng-runtime for any config-lints. I ran `config-lint` and got this snippet:

```
runtime_config:
  gqa_mode: true
  rope_scaling: "auto"
  sliding_window:
    enabled: true
    window_size: 1024
  kv_cache_ttl: 0
```

Warning: rope_scaling=auto + mixed MQA/GQA -> we recommend explicit rope_scale factor for contexts >= 2048.

Ben Ortiz: Good catch. Maria can you try explicit `rope_scale: 0.5` for MQA evals?

Maria Chen: Will push a small runtime patch. Also adding tokenizer fallback mapping for `<|nl|>` -> `\n`. Opening CR: `nova-34b-tokenizer-fix`. @Jess can you review? :thumbsup:

Jess Patel: On it. Quick review ETA ~1h.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment for nova-34b/v1 started in eu-west-1 (canary id c-9823). Watch logs: https://deploys.internal/redwood/c-9823

Ravi Singh: For sliding-window checks — runtime assumes MQA stride=256 when mqa_enabled. If `window_size % stride != 0` we drop stray tokens at the edge. Add to onboarding checklist.

Maria Chen: Adding to onboarding checklist:
- weight sharding validation
- tokenizer sentinel -> vocab mapping
- explicit `rope_scale` when GQA+MQA mixed
- sliding window stride validation
- unit smoke runs on 512, 1024, 2048 ctx

Ben Ortiz: I'll run the smoke on 512/1024 now and post results.

Ben Ortiz: (10m later) 512 OK. 1024 shows a tokenization mismatch at line endings — md5(outputs) differ between loader v2 and v3. Uploading logs to /tmp/nova34b-smoke-1024.log and s3://redwood-smoke/nova34b/1024/logs.tar.gz

Maria Chen: Thanks. If CI is green after Jess review, we can bump canary to 10% in 30m. Otherwise rollback plan ready. (reaction :rocket:)
